s02104.summary: Four teenagers enter the dark silo and bicker nervously about staying until midnight.
A scraping noise from above silences them; Devaki records, Magpie touches the ladder.
Flashlights reveal a pale, folded human shape hanging high on the wall.
They back away, Devaki trips, the camcorder light shows the shape crouching, and everyone runs.

s00118.summary: In the apothecary shop, the constable stands by the door exchanging stiff pleasantries with Ezekiel.
Hendrick reports a death on Pearl Street traced to this shop; Ezekiel denies making poisons.
Madame Lacroix confesses she poisoned her husband and offers her wrists to the constable.
Hendrick asks to hear why; tea is poured and the widow begins her story.

s02453.summary: Ottoline taps SOS into the static while Percival and the captain wait anxiously.
A faint voice answers; Carpathia promises to come, and Ottoline weeps and laughs.
Ottoline sends the reply, leans back, and the room finally goes still.

s00444.summary: Mina plays truth or dare, pressing Hollis about whether he truly likes Priscilla.
Jasper lets slip that their dad sold the boat and Mina cried; Hollis comforts her.
Mina dares Hollis to tell Priscilla the truth, and he reluctantly agrees.

s00613.summary: In the swaying dining car, Quinn serves Vera under the watch of two armed-seeming men.
A glass shatters, Quinn vanishes, Dmitri and Lennox draw guns, and Vera steps between them.
Lennox fires, Vera falls, and the candle goes out.

s00790.summary: Cordelia, her client Tobias and a bailiff ride a courthouse elevator that suddenly stops.
Dispatch says a technician is twenty minutes away, frustrating Cordelia's verdict deadline.
Tobias admits he lied; Cordelia already knew from the lab report and defends him anyway.
The elevator drops, Cordelia steadies Tobias, orders silence, and the doors open.

s01478.summary: Three crew members play cards in the habitat, trading dry banter.
A hull groan is dismissed as sediment; Topside warns of weather while Piotr fears the habitat listens.
Another groan comes closer and Tamsin realizes at the viewport that the silt is rising.
Topside reports a seismic spike and orders evacuation as the hull begins to shriek.

s02395.summary: Inspector Cross presses the young man about three lit lamps, calling him Penhallow.
He says he is Tobias, Penhallow's nephew; the third lamp is for those who don't return.
Cross quietly asks Tobias to tell her everything.

s00473.summary: Wen takes Prakash's toll and makes slow change at the night booth.
A police call asks about a grey Corolla; Wen sees the toddler and Prakash's rigid hands.
Wen lies to the trooper and tells Prakash to take the service road.

s00994.summary: Augustin copies names into a ledger in the catacombs until a footstep echoes.
Celestine emerges, claims to be the sister of a listed prisoner, and challenges his authority.
She names her brother Pierre; Augustin finds the page and weighs it.
Augustin tears out the page, hands it over, and offers a carriage at midnight.

s01956.summary: Eli clumsily brings an injured pigeon to Marisol on the roof coop.
The hatch slams, the pigeon escapes, Marisol catches it and soothes it with a smile.

s00333.summary: Four people in a carousel workshop sense the watching painted horses and argue it is wind.
The horses stir, descend on their chains, and the carousel lurches into motion.

s00373_0.summary: Dot asks the lost-and-found attendant for her big green bird hat.
A stranger wearing her hat tips it, bolts, and Barnaby and Dot give chase.

s01135.summary: Nadia climbs the stairs with groceries until the timer light clicks off.
The light returns on Isaac standing eerily still above her, eyes rolled back.
Isaac advances, whispers not to turn the light off, and the light dies again.
Mr. Okoro restores light, Isaac claims sleepwalking, and Nadia hurries up the stairs shaken.

s00208.summary: Three trekkers push through the rainy bamboo forest, unsure how far the clearing is.
Rain pauses, a rustle sounds, and Hannelore says silence means something is listening.
They argue over which way is left, tangle, and Thabo's radio fails.
They push on while the rustle follows at a constant distance.

s02220.summary: A hooded stranger pays toll at the whalebone bridge and gives the name Tavi.
Brannoch's sister shouts from below; they bicker over whether the ribs sing or whistle.
Tavi walks onto the bridge as Brannoch warns her about the loose rib.

s00413.summary: Morwenna and her mentor Ivar reach a glacier cave where a great presence waits.
The ice groans, a deep note sounds, and a huge slitted eye opens in the dark.
Morwenna raises her spear, Ivar wrestles it from her, insisting on no weapons.
The wind falls away and Morwenna kneels before the eye.

s00860.summary: Marta brings Gideon's belongings to the kiln shed; he stays turned away.
A mug cracks, they trade dry lines, and a photograph reveals they both kept it.
Marta covers her face; Gideon gives her space and waits by the fire.
Marta moves a stool beside him and offers to stay until the first mug cracks.

s00781.summary: Nadia plays her own recorded memos in the car wash control room, wary of the duffel.
The third memo warns they know the car wash; she checks locks and listens to noises.
A memo she never recorded, dated tomorrow, says the duffel holds only a hard drive.
She finds the drive and apology note, laughs, deletes the memo, and walks out.

s00211.summary: Detective Marisol tells the mourners the dead woman was poisoned, unsettling Caleb.
Marisol holds Caleb in place and questions Philomena about who bought and poured the tea.
Philomena leaves; Marisol cracks open the casket lid to inspect something inside.

s00143.summary: The mayor announces the council voted to stop the ferry, and the townspeople despair.
Transit official Irving offers one more year if the town raises forty thousand.
Dot drops a knitted scarf as a starting bid and the others reach for wallets.

s00185.summary: The crew of the sinking trawler waits for the raft, bailing and bickering dryly.
Imelda gives Lin a granola bar and tells her to eat during the long wait.

s01951.summary: Courtier Isidore enters the perfumery and Armand offers him a scent to sample.
Armand names bitter almond, drinks the vial to prove it harmless, and says the poison is in Isidore's pocket.
Armand seizes his wrist, vials shatter, Isidore breaks free and flees.

s01854.summary: Defense and prosecution spar over time before court, and their client asks to speak.
Owen offers five years; Leonor refuses, and Desmond insists he is innocent.
Leonor slides over a page from Owen's own discovery that rattles him.

s00861.summary: A family plays a board game at the cabin with undercurrents of tension around Beatrix.
Beatrix insists on speaking despite Clarissa's interruptions and announces she sold the cabin.

s00219.summary: Roz holds a gun on Vinnie and demands he open the safe all the way.
Roz grabs the paper from the safe, they struggle, and the gun shatters a clock.
The paper is only a receipt for her payment; Roz lowers the gun.

s00449.summary: Detective Oswaldo questions the super and examines the body in the rooftop greenhouse.
He learns only Thaddeus and Hyacinth have keys and notices Hyacinth's muddy feet.

s00842.summary: Guest Tansy wanders into the laundry and claims to seek the ice machine; the staff grow wary.
Calloway offers to escort her, Sabine blocks the stairs, and they reveal knowing who she is.
They ask what she saw in the east elevator; she says nothing, and they open a washer.
Inside a washer hangs a lanyard matching hers, implying a previous victim.

s01948.summary: Josephine brings Cyrus a strike petition signed by Constance and two hundred others.
Cyrus sags, drinks, and agrees to talk in the morning as the women leave.

s02230.summary: A crew cuts into a casino vault until a woman in green walks in.
Ferris draws a pistol; she says she killed the camera and warns the owner is coming.
Imani gives her name, the vault opens, and the crew loads bills.
Kessler calls from the stairs; Imani stops Ferris shooting and goes up to deceive him.
She sends the old man away and the crew slips out through the service tunnel.

s00699.summary: Soldiers hear enemy armor approaching and learn their guns are dead.
Brandt steadies the frightened young Kowalski and tells him to run for the ditch.
A shell lands close and Brandt gives the order to go.

s02312.summary: The family eats stew with strained small talk while Yasmin folds her napkin.
Thaddeus says Cillian looks like a man who sold the boat.
Cillian admits the mortgage is behind and the surveyor was for the bank.
Thaddeus rejects help and goes out onto the deck as the table sits frozen.
